summary: A long single page in four colour-coded chapters (Concept, Languages, Design, Information), driven by one illustrated world: retro American-Swiss snack packaging and airline props, set in every script the family covers. The type tester is a hidden drawer opened from a fixed '↓ Type Tester' link.

instances.look: Pile of flat-illustrated snack boxes, cans and badges in red-orange and electric blue on white, every label set in GT America in many scripts
instances.ux: Fixed corner links: name top-left, '↓ Type Tester' top-right, chapter index and '↑ Trials ↗ Buy' bottom-left
instances.learn: Invent a product universe (snack brands) and letter every package in a different script: the hero proves multi-script coverage before any copy
